name: KiNotes
description: Engineering notes that live inside KiCad — auto-save, Smart-Link, time tracking
description_full:
Your design decisions shouldn't live in a separate notepad. KiNotes keeps engineering notes right inside KiCad—where they belong.

A note written today saves hours tomorrow. A design decision documented now prevents the same argument six months from now.

Features:
• Smart-Link: Click R1, U3, C5 → highlights component on PCB
• Net highlighting: Click VCC, GND, SDA → highlights traces
• Visual WYSIWYG editor (Notion-like experience)
• Auto-save: Your notes survive your forgetting
• Dark/Light themes with custom colors
• Task list with time tracking
• Export to PDF
• Git-friendly .kinotes/ folder storage
• 100% offline, no cloud accounts

Built for engineers who've learned that memory is unreliable, but good notes aren't.

Open source (Apache 2.0) by PCBtools.xyz
